model.about: Mistral AI Ministral 3 14B Instruct (2512), dense, FP8 as published by Mistral. Apache-2.0, EU vendor. Loaded in Mistral's own format as its model card prescribes for vLLM, at temperature 0.05: the card asks for below 0.1 in production. Served with vLLM v0.29.0: v0.30.0 ships transformers 5.17, which renamed a class vLLM's Pixtral code imports, so every Mistral 3 model fails to start there (vllm-project/vllm#58755, fixed on main, no 0.30 patch release). Sends reasoning_effort "none": the app's "low" (a gpt-oss setting) is refused by Mistral models, which accept only none or high (found by the app-shape probe, 2026-09-26). FP8 weights: it failed to compile on an A40 (Ampere, no native FP8).

WITH account_transactions_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel_key,
    c.business_code AS channel_code,
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fat.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
  FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_channel c ON fat.channel_key = c.channel_key
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE
    d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    AND fat.event_status_code = 'COMPLETED'  -- Assuming 'COMPLETED' is the standard for valid transactions
    AND fat.is_reversal = FALSE
    AND fat.is_adjustment = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    c.channel_key, c.business_code, c.display_name
)
SELECT
  channel_code,
  channel_name,
  transaction_count
FROM
  account_transactions_2025
ORDER BY
  transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) AS active_customer_count

WHERE is_current = TRUE

WITH complaint_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    c.complaint_category_key,
    c.display_name AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
  FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category c

WITH portfolio_valuation_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    d.market_id,
    d.market_code,
    d.display_name AS market_name,
    SUM(f.market_value_amount) AS total_portfolio_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.portfolio_id) AS portfolio_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key) AS client_count
  FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily f
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_market d ON f.market_key = d.market_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt ON f.business_date_key = dt.date_key

    AND f.data_quality_status_code = 'GOOD'
    AND d.is_active = TRUE

SELECT
  market_id,
  market_code,
  market_name,
  total_portfolio_value,
  portfolio_count,
  client_count,
  ROUND(total_portfolio_value / NULLIF(portfolio_count, 0), 2) AS avg_portfolio_value,
  ROUND(total_portfolio_value / NULLIF(client_count, 0), 2) AS avg_client_value

WITH loan_product_outstanding AS (
  SELECT
    lp.display_name AS loan_product_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(ld.outstanding_principal_amount), 0) AS total_outstanding_principal
  FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_loan_product lp
  LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.fact_loan_disbursement ld
    ON lp.loan_product_key = ld.loan_product_key
    AND ld.business_date_key = (
      SELECT date_key
      FROM bank_dwh.dim_date
      WHERE calendar_date = '2025-12-31'
    )
  LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.fact_loan_repayment lr
    ON lp.loan_product_key = lr.loan_product_key
    AND lr.business_date_key = (
      SELECT date_key
      FROM bank_dwh.dim_date
      WHERE calendar_date = '2025-12-31'
    )
  WHERE
    lp.is_active = TRUE
    AND lp.effective_to_date IS NULL
    OR lp.effective_to_date > '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    lp.display_name
)
SELECT
  loan_product_name,
  total_outstanding_principal
FROM
  loan_product_outstanding
ORDER BY
  total_outstanding_principal DESC;

  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND c.customer_segment_code = 'SME'

WITH customer_activity AS (
  -- Customers with recent interactions (last 3 months) but no campaign responses
  SELECT
    c.customer_key,
    c.display_name,
    c.customer_segment_code,
    c.customer_status_code,
    c.risk_band_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_interaction_fact_key) AS interaction_count,
    MAX(i.contact_started_at) AS last_interaction_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.customer_campaign_response_fact_key) AS campaign_response_count
  FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_customer c
  LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.fact_customer_interaction i
    ON c.customer_key = i.customer_key
    AND i.business_date_key = (
      SELECT date_key
      FROM bank_dwh.dim_date
      WHERE calendar_date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    )
    AND i.contact_started_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
  LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.fact_customer_campaign_response cr
    ON c.customer_key = cr.customer_key
    AND cr.business_date_key = (
      SELECT date_key
      FROM bank_dwh.dim_date
      WHERE calendar_date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    )
    AND cr.contact_started_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
  WHERE
    c.is_active = TRUE
    AND c.is_current = TRUE
    AND c.closure_date IS NULL
    AND c.deceased_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    c.customer_key, c.display_name, c.customer_segment_code, c.customer_status_code, c.risk_band_code
),

  churn_risk AS (
  -- Customers with declining engagement patterns
  SELECT

    CASE WHEN ca.campaign_response_count = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS no_campaign_response,
    -- Risk band (higher risk = higher churn likelihood)
    CASE

      WHEN ca.risk_band_code IN ('LOW') THEN 1

WITH customer_activity AS (
    -- Customers with recent interactions (last 3 months) but no campaign responses
    SELECT
        c.customer_key,
        c.display_name,
        c.customer_segment_code,
        c.customer_status_code,
        c.risk_band_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_interaction_fact_key) AS interaction_count,
        MAX(i.contact_started_at) AS last_interaction_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.customer_campaign_response_fact_key) AS campaign_response_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.dim_customer c
    LEFT JOIN
        bank_dwh.fact_customer_interaction i
        ON c.customer_key = i.customer_key
        AND i.business_date_key = (
            SELECT date_key
            FROM bank_dwh.dim_date
            WHERE calendar_date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
        )
    LEFT JOIN
        bank_dwh.fact_customer_campaign_response cr
        ON c.customer_key = cr.customer_key
        AND cr.business_date_key = (
            SELECT date_key
            FROM bank_dwh.dim_date
            WHERE calendar_date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
        )
    WHERE
        c.is_active = TRUE
        AND c.is_current = TRUE
        AND c.closure_date IS NULL
        AND c.deceased_flag = FALSE
        AND i.contact_started_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    GROUP BY
        c.customer_key, c.display_name, c.customer_segment_code, c.customer_status_code, c.risk_band_code
    HAVING
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_interaction_fact_key) > 0
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.customer_campaign_response_fact_key) = 0
),

    customer_risk AS (
    -- Customers with declining engagement (fewer interactions over time)
    SELECT
        c.customer_key,
        c.display_name,
        c.customer_segment_code,
        c.customer_status_code,
        c.risk_band_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_interaction_fact_key) AS interaction_count,
        MAX(i.contact_started_at) AS last_interaction_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.contact_started_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month' THEN 1 END) AS recent_interaction_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.dim_customer c
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.fact_customer_interaction i
        ON c.customer_key = i.customer_key
        AND i.contact_started_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months'
    WHERE
        c.is_active = TRUE
        AND c.is_current = TRUE
        AND c.closure_date IS NULL
        AND c.deceased_flag = FALSE
    GROUP BY
        c.customer_key, c.display_name, c.customer_segment_code, c.customer_status_code, c.risk_band_code
    HAVING
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_interaction_fact_key) > 0
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.contact_started_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month' THEN 1 END) = 0
)

SELECT

    COALESCE(ca.customer_status_code, cr.customer_status_code) AS customer_status_code,
    COALESCE(ca.risk_band_code, cr.risk_band_code) AS risk_band_code,
    COALESCE(ca.interaction_count, cr.interaction_count) AS interaction_count,
    COALESCE(ca.last_interaction_date, cr.last_interaction_date) AS last_interaction_date,
    CASE
        WHEN ca.customer_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'Recent_Interactions_No_Campaign_Response'
        WHEN cr.customer_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'Declining_Engagement'

    FROM

        AND i.business_date_key = (

    c.legal_name,
    c.industry_code,
    -- Assuming ESG ratings are stored in corporate_action_fact_key with event_type_code indicating ESG
    -- If this assumption is incorrect, please clarify the field containing ESG ratings.
    MAX(CASE WHEN fca.event_type_code = 'ESG_Rating' THEN fca.event_id ELSE NULL END) AS esg_rating_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fca.event_type_code = 'ESG_Rating' THEN fca.event_status_code ELSE NULL END) AS esg_rating_status,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fca.event_type_code = 'ESG_Rating' THEN fca.updated_at ELSE NULL END) AS esg_rating_updated_at
  FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
  JOIN bank_dwh.fact_corporate_action fca ON c.customer_key = fca.customer_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fca.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE c.customer_key IN (SELECT customer_key FROM corporate_borrowers)
    AND fca.event_type_code IN ('ESG_Rating', 'ESG_Update') -- Assuming these event types contain ESG data
    AND d.is_business_day = TRUE
  GROUP BY d.calendar_date, c.customer_key, c.legal_name, c.industry_code
)

WITH current_customers AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_key,
    given_name,
    family_name,
    CASE
      WHEN given_name ~ '[A-Z]' AND family_name ~ '[A-Z]' THEN 'Unknown'
      WHEN given_name ~ '[A-Z]' THEN 'Male'
      WHEN family_name ~ '[A-Z]' THEN 'Female'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS gender_heuristic
  FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
  WHERE is_current = TRUE
    AND is_active = TRUE
    AND deceased_flag = FALSE
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(gender_heuristic, 'Unknown') AS gender,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS customer_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage_of_total
FROM current_customers
GROUP BY gender_heuristic
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH duplicates AS (

    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT record_hash, ', ' ORDER BY record_hash) AS record_hashes,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT business_id, ', ' ORDER BY business_id) AS business_ids
  FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_customer
  WHERE
    is_active = TRUE
  GROUP BY
    customer_key
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
)

  c.customer_key,
  c.business_id,
  c.record_hash,
  c.legal_name,
  c.email_hash,
  c.phone_hash,
  d.duplicate_count,
  d.record_hashes AS all_record_hashes,
  d.business_ids AS all_business_ids
FROM
  bank_dwh.dim_customer c
JOIN
  duplicates d ON c.customer_key = d.customer_key
ORDER BY
  d.duplicate_count DESC, c.customer_key;

WITH wire_transfer_volume AS (
  SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    SUM(COALESCE(f.original_amount, 0)) AS total_volume
  FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE
    d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    AND f.event_status_code = 'COMPLETED'  -- Assuming 'COMPLETED' indicates successful transfers
    AND f.is_returned = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    c.iso_alpha_code
)
SELECT
  currency_code,
  total_volume
FROM
  wire_transfer_volume
ORDER BY
  total_volume DESC;
